shell_commands: timeout 300 npm test -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts 2>&1 | grep -A 5 "Error message"

git add -A && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(tools): correct ErrorObject type annotation in validation errors

Use proper ErrorObject type from ajv for error handler parameters to resolve
TypeScript type compatibility issues. Add unit test verifying error messages
include field names and expected types without leaking values.
EOF
)" && git status
git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main && git push origin HEAD

npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && git add -A && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(tools): extract property name in type validation errors

Extract the property name from the JSON Pointer path (e.g., 'ssn' from '/ssn')
to ensure type validation error messages clearly identify the failing property
without including the offending value.
EOF
)" && git status
git push origin HEAD && git status

npx prettier --write specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md CHANGELOG.md && git add -A && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
docs: update spec status to Implemented and add changelog entry

Update the tool input validation spec status from 'In Progress' to 'Implemented'
since the feature is fully implemented with tests. Add changelog entry describing
the tool input validation feature for npm consumers.
EOF
)" && git status
git push origin HEAD && git status
